annotations.title: Coverage and citation formats by source

description: Returns GLO’s coverage statements as text, so each tool’s and each source’s limits can be read on request. With a tool name alone: that tool’s full statement of coverage, measured limits and field meanings ("server" gives the full server overview). With a source or state code: for get_statute and search_statute_text, that regulation source’s coverage, citation forms, served and held counts and read dates (e.g. "cfr", "fl", "de"); for find_agency_policies, that department’s (e.g. "ks", "bop"). Returns tool, source, text, argument_descriptions, sources_available and a note. Read-only and served from the tool layer itself, with no database query. Each data tool’s own response note and coverage_note remain the record for that response.

source.description: optional: a regulation source code for get_statute or search_statute_text (e.g. "cfr", "fl"), or a department code for find_agency_policies (e.g. "ks", "bop")

tool.description: a tool name, or "server" for the full server overview
